settings.label: This semester page
settings.hint: A page {{name}} at the root of your vault that lists your courses and the projects in progress. The app keeps it up to date, so you never edit it by hand.
settings.trashed: The This semester page is in the trash.

state.ok: The app keeps {{name}} up to date. Last update: {{time}}.
state.edited: {{name}} was edited outside the app, so the app no longer overwrites it. Click Regenerate for a fresh page (the edited copy goes to the trash).
state.missing: {{name}} was deleted. Click Regenerate if you want it back.
state.pending: {{name}} could not be created yet. Click Regenerate to try again.
state.offKept: {{name}} stays in your vault as an ordinary note.

done.enable: Turned on. {{name}} is at the root of your vault.
done.disable: Turned off. {{name}} stays in your vault.

banner.generated: The app makes this page by itself. To change it, edit your course and project notes.
banner.edited: This page was edited outside the app, so the app no longer updates it. Click Regenerate for a fresh page (the edited copy goes to the trash).

errors.generatedPage: The app makes the This semester page, so it cannot be edited, renamed or moved. To keep it as an ordinary note, turn the page off in Settings.

confirm.title: Regenerate the This semester page?
confirm.body: The current page was edited outside the app. That copy goes to the trash (you can restore it), then the app makes a fresh page from your course and project notes.
